name: Upper Trapezius Stretch
short_description: Tilt the ear toward the shoulder and gently assist with the same-side hand while the opposite shoulder relaxes down.

name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
short_description: Turn the head about 45 degrees and look down toward the armpit, gently pulling the head down with the hand.

name: Neck Flexion and Extension
short_description: Slowly lower the chin to the chest, then lift the gaze toward the ceiling, without forcing the range.

name: Chin Tucks
short_description: Glide the head straight back to make a double chin, hold briefly, and release.

name: Scalene Stretch
short_description: Anchor one shoulder down, tilt the head away and slightly back, looking up diagonally.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
short_description: Pull one straight arm across the chest with the other hand, keeping the shoulder down.

name: Sleeper Stretch
short_description: Lying on one side with the bottom arm at 90 degrees, gently press the forearm toward the floor.

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
short_description: Reach one arm overhead, bend the elbow behind the head, and gently pull the elbow with the other hand.

name: Standing Shoulder Extension Stretch
short_description: Clasp the hands behind the back and lift the arms away from the body while the chest stays tall.

name: Standing Chest Stretch
short_description: Interlace the fingers behind the back, squeeze the shoulder blades, and open the chest.

name: Doorway Pec Stretch
short_description: Place the forearm on a doorframe or wall at shoulder height and step through until the chest stretches.

name: Prone Single-Arm Pec Stretch
short_description: Lie face down with one arm out at 90 degrees and roll away from it, bracing with the other hand.

name: Seated Biceps Stretch
short_description: Sit with knees bent, hands behind you with fingers pointing back, and slide the hips forward.

name: Puppy Pose
short_description: From hands and knees, walk the hands forward and lower the chest toward the floor with hips over the knees.

name: Thread the Needle Hold
short_description: From hands and knees, slide one arm under the body and rest that shoulder and ear on the floor.

name: Open Book Hold
short_description: Lie on your side with knees stacked and bent, and rotate the top arm open to rest behind you.

name: Seated Spinal Twist
short_description: Sit with one knee bent and crossed over the straight leg, and rotate toward the bent knee using the opposite elbow.

name: Supine Spinal Twist
short_description: Lie on your back, drop bent knees to one side, and keep both shoulders on the floor.

name: Bench Thoracic Extension Stretch
short_description: Kneel facing a bench, place the elbows on it with hands together, and sink the chest down while bending the elbows.

name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
short_description: Lie with a roller under the upper back, hands behind the head, and extend back over it, moving it up a segment at a time.

name: Sphinx Pose
short_description: Lie face down and prop up on the forearms, letting the low back and belly relax.

name: Cobra Stretch
short_description: Lying face down with hands under the shoulders, press the chest up while the hips stay down.

name: Upward-Facing Dog
short_description: From prone, press up through straight arms lifting the thighs off the floor and opening the chest.

name: Child's Pose
short_description: Sit the hips back to the heels with knees apart and arms extended forward, breathing into the back.

name: Side-Reach Child's Pose
short_description: From child's pose, walk both hands to one side to lengthen the opposite lat.

name: 90 Lat Stretch
short_description: Stand facing a support, hold it at about hip height, and sit the hips back while reaching through one arm.

name: Kneeling Lat Stretch on Bench
short_description: Kneel beside a bench, place one forearm on it, and sink the hips back and chest down.

name: Standing Side Bend
short_description: Reach one arm overhead and lean the torso to the opposite side without twisting.

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
short_description: With the arm straight and palm up, gently pull the fingers back toward you.

name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
short_description: With the arm straight and palm down, gently pull the back of the hand toward you.

name: Prayer Stretch
short_description: Press the palms together in front of the chest and lower the hands while keeping the palms in contact.

name: Reverse Prayer Stretch
short_description: Press the backs of the hands together with fingers pointing down and lift the elbows slightly.

name: Kneeling Wrist Stretch (Fingers Back)
short_description: On hands and knees, turn the fingers to point toward the knees and gently lean back.

name: Forearm Soft-Tissue Roll
short_description: Roll the forearm slowly over a massage ball on a table, pausing on tender spots.

name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
short_description: In a half-kneeling position, tuck the pelvis and shift forward until the front of the rear hip stretches.

name: Couch Stretch
short_description: With the back knee near a wall or couch and the shin up it, step the other foot forward and lift the torso tall.

name: Low Lunge
short_description: Sink into a long lunge with the back knee down and arms overhead, keeping the pelvis tucked.

name: Pigeon Stretch
short_description: With the front shin angled across the body and the back leg extended, lower the hips and fold forward.

name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
short_description: Sit with the front and back legs each bent 90 degrees and lean the torso over the front shin.

name: Supine 90-90 Hip Rotator Stretch
short_description: Lying on your back with one ankle crossed on the opposite knee, draw the legs toward the chest.

name: Deep Squat Hold
short_description: Sit into the deepest comfortable squat with heels down and elbows gently pressing the knees out.

name: Happy Baby
short_description: On your back, hold the outside of the feet with knees bent toward the armpits and rock gently.

name: Hip Controlled Articular Rotations
short_description: On hands and knees or standing, draw the biggest controlled circle possible with one knee while keeping the rest of the body still.

name: Standing Iliotibial Band Stretch
short_description: Stand beside a wall, cross the inside leg behind the outside leg, and lean the hip toward the wall.

name: Supine Figure-Four Stretch
short_description: Lying on your back, cross one ankle over the opposite knee and pull the bottom thigh toward the chest.

name: Seated Figure-Four Stretch
short_description: Sitting tall, cross one ankle over the opposite knee and hinge forward with a flat back.

name: Knee-to-Opposite-Shoulder Stretch
short_description: Lying on your back, pull one bent knee toward the opposite shoulder.

name: Single Knee-to-Chest
short_description: Lying on your back, hug one knee to the chest while the other leg stays relaxed.

name: Double Knee-to-Chest
short_description: Lying on your back, hug both knees to the chest and gently rock side to side.

name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
short_description: Lying on your back, lift one straight leg and hold behind the thigh (or with a towel) until the back of the leg stretches.

name: Seated Forward Fold
short_description: Sit with legs straight and hinge from the hips to reach toward the toes with a long spine.

name: Modified Hurdler's Stretch
short_description: Sit with one leg straight and the other foot against the inner thigh, and fold over the straight leg.

name: Half-Kneeling Hamstring Stretch
short_description: From half-kneeling, shift the hips back over the rear knee and straighten the front leg with toes up.

name: Standing Forward Fold
short_description: Hinge forward with soft knees and let the torso hang, holding opposite elbows.

name: Wall Hamstring Stretch
short_description: Lie near a doorway or wall with one heel up the wall and slowly straighten the knee.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
short_description: Standing tall, hold one ankle behind you and pull the heel toward the glute with knees together.

name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
short_description: Lying on your side, hold the top ankle and pull the heel toward the glute, gently pressing the hip forward.

name: Kneeling Quad Stretch
short_description: From half-kneeling, reach back to hold the rear foot and draw it toward the glute.

name: Wall Calf Stretch (Straight Knee)
short_description: Hands on a wall, step one leg back with heel down and knee straight, and lean forward.

name: Wall Soleus Stretch (Bent Knee)
short_description: In the wall calf position, bend the back knee while keeping the heel down to target the lower calf.

name: Downward-Facing Dog
short_description: From a plank, push the hips up and back into an inverted V, pressing the heels toward the floor.

name: Step Calf Stretch
short_description: Stand with the ball of one foot on a step and slowly lower the heel below the step.

name: Seated Calf Stretch with Towel
short_description: Sit with legs straight, loop a towel around the ball of one foot, and gently pull the toes toward you.

name: Kneeling Shin Stretch
short_description: Kneel with the tops of the feet flat on the floor and sit back onto the heels, lifting the knees slightly if comfortable.

name: Toe Sit
short_description: Kneel with the toes tucked under and sit back on the heels.

name: Ankle Circles
short_description: Seated or standing, draw slow, full circles with one foot while keeping the shin still.

name: Butterfly Stretch
short_description: Sit with the soles of the feet together and knees out, and hinge forward with a long spine.

name: Frog Stretch
short_description: From hands and knees, slide the knees wide with shins parallel and ease the hips back.

name: Seated Straddle Stretch
short_description: Sit with legs wide and hinge forward from the hips, walking the hands out.

name: Seated Side Straddle Stretch
short_description: In a wide seated straddle, reach toward one foot while keeping the chest open.

name: Side Lunge Stretch
short_description: Shift into a side lunge with the straight leg's toes up and hold the bottom position.

name: Quadruped Adductor Rock-Back
short_description: On hands and knees with one leg out straight to the side, rock the hips back and forth.

name: Slow Cat-Camel
short_description: Move slowly between spinal flexion and extension on hands and knees, timing each with a slow breath.

name: Supine Pelvic Tilts
short_description: Lying on your back with knees bent, gently flatten and then arch the low back.

name: Foam Roll Quadriceps
short_description: Lying face down with the roller under the thighs, roll slowly from hip to just above the knee, pausing on tender spots.

name: Foam Roll Lateral Thigh
short_description: Lie on your side on the roller and roll slowly between the hip and knee, supporting with the top leg.

name: Foam Roll Calves
short_description: Sit with the roller under the calves and roll from ankle to knee, crossing one leg over for more pressure.

name: Foam Roll Lats
short_description: Lie on your side with the arm overhead and the roller under the armpit area, rolling slowly along the side of the back.

name: Foam Roll Adductors
short_description: Lie face down with one leg out to the side and the roller under the inner thigh, rolling from knee to groin.

name: Foam Roll Glutes
short_description: Sit on the roller with one ankle crossed over the opposite knee and lean into the crossed-leg glute.

name: Foam Roll Hamstrings
short_description: Sit with the roller under the hamstrings and roll from just above the knee to the glute.

name: Massage Ball Pec Release
short_description: Pin a massage ball between the chest and a wall below the collarbone and move the arm slowly.

name: Massage Ball Foot Roll
short_description: Roll the sole of the foot slowly over a massage ball from heel to toes.

name: Box Breathing
short_description: Inhale for 4 counts, hold for 4, exhale for 4, and hold for 4, repeating calmly.

name: Supine Diaphragmatic Breathing
short_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, one hand on the chest and one on the belly, and breathe so only the belly hand rises.

name: Crocodile Breathing
short_description: Lie face down with the forehead on the hands and breathe into the belly so the low back rises and falls.

name: 4-7-8 Breathing
short_description: Inhale through the nose for 4 counts, hold for 7, and exhale fully through the mouth for 8.

name: Cyclic Sighing
short_description: Take a full inhale through the nose, a second short top-up inhale, then a long slow exhale through the mouth; repeat.

name: Legs Up the Wall
short_description: Lie on your back with the hips near a wall and the legs resting up it, breathing slowly.

name: 90/90 Wall Breathing
short_description: Lie on your back with hips and knees at 90 degrees and feet on a wall, tuck the pelvis slightly, and take slow full exhales.
